verdict.rationale: Whether user data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for an AI coding agent like Codex, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-usage control, or a no-training guarantee. Mentions of Business/Enterprise plans, RBAC, and sandbox permissions are adjacent features and do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
